referral.reason_text: Persisting dysphagia to solids despite PPI. Gastroscopy 2024-01 showed oesophagitis only.

deciding.fast_track_met: Dysphagia persists despite PPI, which fits the fast-track criterion. The recent gastroscopy showing oesophagitis only, with stable symptoms and no 'progressive' wording, keeps it open.
deciding.vetting_outcome: The record is complete, with recent Hb and gastroscopy results. Persisting dysphagia on a PPI is the feature that decides an earlier slot.
deciding.first_contact: Only one comorbidity (GORD) and a simple medication list favour a nurse clinic. Persisting dysphagia after a gastroscopy keeps a consultant visit defensible.
deciding.clinical_urgency: Symptoms are unchanged since December, weight change is 0 and Hb is normal. The one red-flag feature is largely explained by the oesophagitis, which leaves a little doubt.
deciding.record_agreement: Stated age 71 against a DOB of 1952-03-01 that gives 72 at the sent date. This is a birthday-boundary slip that may be read as trivial or as one material mismatch. Everything else agrees.
